# Shampoo — Atopic (Standalone Dashboard)

> Living document — update after every bug fix or new pattern found.

## Purpose

Amazon market analysis for **atopic / sensitive-scalp shampoo** (Neurodermitis / atopische Kopfhaut). Tied to the ICB Pharma Amazon-EU work (`02-Projects/ICB PHARMA/`).

## Status

**Live — TOPLINE built (5 markets).** All 5 markets segmented (DE/UK/FR/IT/ES) and the topline `index.html` is generated by `_build_topline.py`. Hub: `topline` group, `template: "standalone"`, title "Shampoo — Atopic (DE, UK, FR, IT, ES)".

### Topline build (`_build_topline.py`, 2026-06-30)
- Reads the final per-market `data/x-ray/shampoo-atopic-{CODE}.csv`, **filters to `Segment == "Irritated / Atopic"`** (so DE's option-B file contributes only its 115 atopic rows), aggregates at **ASIN level** (sum `ASIN Revenue` / `ASIN Sales`), 12M = 30d × 12.
- **Currency: all €. UK £→€ at `GBP_TO_EUR = 1.16117`** (mid-market, captured 2026-06-30 — edit the constant when refreshing UK). Price column detected by regex (`Price £` vs `Price €`).
- Contents: KPI strip, method callout (EN+PL), Revenue/Units bars, share doughnut, EU-pooled top-brands bar, market summary table, Top-20 products per market (country pills). Per-country Edit X-Ray buttons (`XRAY_LINKS`, `#` placeholders).
- Build totals: **€49.85M/12M, 4.20M units, 309 shampoos, 99 brands.** Per market 12M: UK €23.5M (£→€; high-revenue clinical anti-dandruff e.g. Nizoral), DE €11.0M, IT €6.36M, ES €5.95M, FR €2.98M. Markets auto-sorted by revenue (UK/DE/IT/ES/FR).
- Rebuild: `cd dashboards/shampoo-atopic && py _build_topline.py`.

## Build conventions (Console standard)

- **Zero Hardcoded Values** — every number from CSV; only Reviews VOC may be AI-analyzed.
- **Segment column** named `Segment`, placed 3rd (after ASIN), added during the X-Ray merge step.
- X-Ray read with `encoding='utf-8-sig'` (BOM); German umlaut mojibake fixed via latin-1↔utf-8 round-trip if needed.
- If multiple DE keyword exports: merge + dedupe by ASIN (keep higher `ASIN Revenue`), like the `atopic` build.

## Segmentation rules — CRITICAL (apply AFTER the X-Ray merge, before building)

Segmentation is **claim-based** (read the actual listing text), NOT category/browse-node based. A product in the Amazon "shampoo" node that is really a conditioner/lotion/serum must still be excluded.

**Data source for claims — IMPORTANT:** the H10 X-Ray export holds **only the title** (`Product Details`) — **no bullets/description** (33 cols, none are bullets). To read bullets, fetch per-ASIN via the **DataForSEO Amazon API** (`merchant_amazon_asin_live_advanced`, amazon.de) — **Tom approved API use**. Title = first pass; bullets = confirmation of the shampoo gate + segment.

**Step 0 — revenue floor + brand keep-list (which ASINs stay in the file).**
- **Default:** drop any ASIN with **< €1000 `ASIN Revenue` / 30 days**.
- **Exception (overrides the floor):** if the ASIN's brand is on the keep-list below **and it is a shampoo**, KEEP it regardless of revenue (even < €1000).
- **Brand keep-list:** Dr Irena Eris · Emolium · La Roche-Posay · Farmina · ARISTO PHARMA · Bioderma · POLPHARMA S.A · Pierre Fabre.
  - Match case-insensitive, ignore punctuation/spacing (`La Roche Posay` == `La Roche-Posay`).
  - Corporate owners may appear under sub-brands (e.g. Pierre Fabre → Ducray/Klorane/A-Derma/René Furterer; Emolium → Nepentes/Sanofi). Flag uncertain brand→owner matches for Tom rather than assume.

**Step 1 — HARD GATE: every kept product must be 100% a shampoo.**
- Read title (+ bullets via API) for each surviving ASIN. Keep ONLY genuine **shampoo**.
- Exclude conditioners, masks, balms, creams, body/face lotions & washes, sprays, serums, oils, accessories, and mixed sets/bundles that aren't pure shampoo.
- Not definitely (100%) a shampoo → exclude (leave `Segment` blank / drop). When in doubt, exclude + flag Tom.

**Step 2 — assign the segment.**
- Single segment label (Tom's wording): **`Irritated / Atopic`**.
- Assign `Segment = "Irritated / Atopic"` to shampoos whose claims address **irritated, sensitive, reactive, itchy, atopic, or dermatological / barrier-protective** skin/scalp (Neurodermitis, atopische / empfindliche / gereizte / juckende Kopfhaut, etc.).
- Shampoos clearly something else (pure anti-dandruff, volumizing, colour, anti-hair-loss with no irritated/atopic claim) → leave unsegmented / out, unless Tom adds more buckets.
- Write into the **`Segment`** column (3rd, after `ASIN`).

**Step 3 — reference logic: reference products (PL).**
- ~8 reference shampoos (Emolium, Physiogel, Mediderm, Bioderma Node, Eloderm, Ducray Extra Doux, …) — **pasted by Tom 2026-06-30, saved in [`reference-products.md`](reference-products.md)** with the distilled qualifying-signal set (PL↔DE) + exclusions.
- Use them to calibrate the claim signals that map an ASIN to `Irritated / Atopic`. Language-agnostic (reference PL, listings DE — match on meaning, not literal words).

## Classification runs (2026-06-30)

**FR** — 3 exports → 79 unique ASINs → 45 candidates (≥€1000 OR keep-list, fr_FR/France) → 45 fetched (6 agents) → **36 shampoos, 32 Irritated/Atopic, 9 non-shampoo dropped**. Non-shampoo = 5 dog shampoos (FR keyword pulled lots of pet) + 3 mixed sets/2-in-1 (H&S 2-en-1 ×2, H&S shampoo+masque, 3-product set) + 1 Vichy DS 2-in-1. Option A applied: dropped 4 cosmetic (Wella purifiant €8.9k, Vichy Minéral Doux €7.2k, L'Oréal Dermo-Purifiant €2.4k, Phyto Softness €1.9k). Final `shampoo-atopic-FR.csv` = 32 Irritated/Atopic, €248,586/30d. Several M-confidence atopic kept (Corine de Farme B0DCW4Y3WT, Valquer B084S5J95Q, ELEVEN B09ZYTKDRB, Redken Amino Mint B09LYWXD3Q).

**UK** — 3 exports → 89 unique ASINs → 76 candidates (≥£1000 OR keep-list; UK = **£**) → 76 fetched (en_GB/United Kingdom, 6 agents) → **66 shampoos, 63 Irritated/Atopic, 10 non-shampoo dropped**. Non-shampoo = mostly shampoo+conditioner sets/2-in-1 (Roycederm, MooGoo, H&S 2-in-1 ×2, ican London, Philip Kingsley duo, Botanic Hearth) + Healpsorin cream bundle + Australian Bodycare leave-in serum + 2 Batiste dry shampoos. Option A applied: dropped 3 cosmetic (OGX Biotin £40.7k, OGX Rosemary Mint £26.7k, Dove Density&Growth £18k). Final `shampoo-atopic-UK.csv` = 63 Irritated/Atopic, £1,689,943/30d. 2 M-confidence atopic kept: B0G3X1LSJQ (Dove Soothing, no anti-dandruff claim), B09LYWXD3Q (Redken Amino Mint, oily-scalp). **Open Q for Tom:** count shampoo+conditioner sets? (currently excluded by the 100%-shampoo gate). Note: step2 print label says € but UK is £.

**ES** — 3 exports → 86 unique ASINs → 50 candidates (≥€1000 OR keep-list) → 0 pre-dropped → 50 fetched (es_ES/Spain, 6 agents) → **50 shampoos, 48 Irritated/Atopic, 0 non-shampoo**. Option A applied: dropped 2 cosmetic (Kérastase Spécifique €38.9k, Vichy Anticaída €27.5k). Final `shampoo-atopic-ES.csv` = 48 Irritated/Atopic, €495,770/30d. One M-confidence call: B018KA85SU (Bionatar, empty copy, tagged from metadata).

**IT** — 3 exports (2 byte-identical) → 74 unique → 53 shampoos, 51 Irritated/Atopic. Option A applied: dropped 2 cosmetic (L'Oréal Pro oily-scalp B0BPYFBWF4, Faith In Nature B0C4YJSRHM). Final `shampoo-atopic-IT.csv` = 51.

**DE** (below) — still option B (115 atopic + 20 cosmetic in file).

- Merged 26 DE exports → 283 ASINs → filter (≥€1000 OR keep-list brand incl. Pierre Fabre subs A-Derma/Ducray, shampoos only) → 205 candidates → 51 clear non-shampoos pre-dropped → **154 fetched via DataForSEO** (`merchant_amazon_asin_live_advanced`, de_DE/Germany) and classified by 6 parallel agents.
- Working files in `_classify/` (`_fetch_list.csv`, `_chunk_*.txt`, `_results_chunk*.csv`). Results merged into the `Segment` column of `data/x-ray/shampoo-atopic-DE.csv`.
- Keep-list brands matched on amazon.de: **Bioderma, La Roche-Posay, A-Derma, Ducray**. Not present: Dr Irena Eris, Emolium, Farmina, ARISTO PHARMA, POLPHARMA (treated as absent).

**Output for Tom's review:** (a) ASINs dropped + reason (< €1000 / non-shampoo), (b) kept ASINs with `Segment` + the title/bullet phrase that justified it, (c) any uncertain brand or shampoo-gate calls.

**Output of the segmentation pass:** for Tom's review — (a) list of ASINs excluded as non-shampoo with the reason, (b) the `Segment` assignment per kept ASIN with the bullet/title phrase that justified it.
